about: The crypt's Long gallery (docs/milestones/connected-biomes.md, CB13): a fight room, a floating slab of the crypt's flagstones; its landmark a long gallery of four sarcophagi in two rows, two pillars down its middle, candles burning along it. Its edge a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall), held straight under its sockets (west, east, north, south) by pins. tools/ground_shape.py draws arena_11_ground.tscn and its art from this.
